project-management.opportunity: Niche vertical PM tools still win (e.g. Shortcut for eng, Planhat for CS)
project-management.icp: Product & engineering teams at mid-market startups (50-500 employees) who need async task coordination
project-management.icpWhy: Teams at this size outgrow spreadsheets but find enterprise tools bloated — highest willingness to pay for focused solutions

crm.opportunity: Vertical CRMs (real estate, recruiting, agencies) still viable
crm.icp: Sales-led B2B startups with 5-50 person sales teams managing complex deal cycles
crm.icpWhy: These teams generate enough revenue per rep to justify CRM spend but need faster setup than Salesforce

analytics.icp: Growth-stage product teams (Series A-C) who need behavioral analytics beyond Google Analytics
analytics.icpWhy: Post-PMF companies need retention/funnel data to optimize — high urgency, clear budget allocation

ai-writing.opportunity: Workflow-specific tools (legal briefs, medical notes, SEC filings)
ai-writing.icp: Content marketers and copywriters at SMBs producing 10+ pieces/week who need speed over polish
ai-writing.icpWhy: Volume writers get immediate ROI from AI — measurable time savings with high output pressure

ecommerce.opportunity: Niche: digital products, creator commerce, B2B ecommerce
ecommerce.icp: Solo creators and small brands ($10K-$500K revenue) selling digital or niche physical products
ecommerce.icpWhy: Underserved by Shopify's complexity — willing to pay for simplicity and creator-friendly UX

scheduling.icp: Service professionals (consultants, coaches, therapists) booking 20+ meetings/week
scheduling.icpWhy: High frequency schedulers feel the pain daily — scheduling is their bottleneck, not a nice-to-have

form-builder.opportunity: Verticalized forms (intake, compliance, surveys with analysis)
form-builder.icp: Operations and marketing teams at SMBs collecting structured data (leads, feedback, applications)
form-builder.icpWhy: Forms are the gateway to workflows — teams with high submission volume need advanced logic and integrations

email-marketing.icp: Solo creators and newsletter operators with 1K-50K subscribers monetizing through sponsorships or paid subs
email-marketing.icpWhy: Newsletter economics are clear — every subscriber has a dollar value, making tool ROI easy to justify

no-code-builder.opportunity: Vertical solutions built on no-code (specific industry apps)
no-code-builder.icp: Non-technical founders and ops teams at SMBs building internal tools or MVPs without developers
no-code-builder.icpWhy: The cost of hiring a developer ($150K+/yr) makes $200/mo tools an obvious ROI for simple app needs

social-media-tool.icp: Solopreneurs and small marketing teams managing 3+ social channels with daily posting schedules
social-media-tool.icpWhy: Multi-channel management is a daily time sink — the pain is acute and recurring, driving consistent renewals

developer-tool.opportunity: Specialized dev tools (testing, monitoring, niche infra)
developer-tool.icp: Full-stack developers and small engineering teams (2-10 devs) shipping SaaS products
developer-tool.icpWhy: Developers adopt tools bottoms-up and have purchasing influence — low CAC through community and content

design-tool.icp: Product designers and marketing teams at startups who need fast visual output without enterprise complexity
design-tool.icpWhy: Design tools are daily-use software — high switching cost once workflows are built, strong retention

fintech.opportunity: Vertical fintech (creator payouts, freelancer invoicing, micro-lending)
fintech.icp: SMBs and freelancers processing $10K-$1M/month in transactions who need simpler alternatives to banks
fintech.icpWhy: Financial pain is visceral — high fees, slow payouts, and poor UX create strong motivation to switch

education.opportunity: Cohort-based learning, AI tutoring, skill-specific platforms
education.icp: Course creators and coaches with an existing audience (1K+ followers) looking to monetize expertise
education.icpWhy: Creators with audiences have proven demand — they just need a platform to convert followers to paying students

health-wellness.opportunity: Niche wellness (sleep, nutrition tracking, mental health journaling)
health-wellness.icp: Health-conscious millennials and Gen-Z (25-40) willing to pay for digital wellness subscriptions
health-wellness.icpWhy: This demographic spends on self-improvement, has high digital literacy, and discovers products through social proof
